Motherboard (main Pcb).name: Silicon
Motherboard (main Pcb).reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor material forming the basis of integrated circuits on the motherboard, absolutely essential as it defines the chip functionality.

Motherboard (main Pcb).name: Copper
Motherboard (main Pcb).reasoning: Copper is the primary conductor used in PCB traces and internal wiring for efficient electrical signal transmission, universally used on motherboards.

Motherboard (main Pcb).name: Tin
Motherboard (main Pcb).reasoning: Tin is used in solder alloys for component mounting on the PCB, a standard industrial material for reliable electrical and mechanical connections.

Motherboard (main Pcb).name: Epoxy resins
Motherboard (main Pcb).reasoning: Epoxy resins form the insulating and binding substrate material of the PCB, providing mechanical support and dielectric properties.

Motherboard (main Pcb).name: Glass
Motherboard (main Pcb).reasoning: Glass fibers are used in the PCB substrate weave (fiberglass), supporting the epoxy and providing mechanical strength and insulation.

Motherboard (main Pcb).name: Gold
Motherboard (main Pcb).reasoning: Gold is often used as surface plating for connectors and contacts on the motherboard for corrosion resistance and reliable conductivity, though alternatives like nickel exist.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Lithium is the essential element in lithium-ion battery chemistry, crucial for energy storage with no practical substitutes.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Copper
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Copper serves as the anode current collector enabling electrical conduction inside the battery cells, universally essential.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Aluminum
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Aluminum is used as the cathode current collector and casing material offering lightweight strength, industry standard.

Lithium-ion Battery Pack.name: Graphite
Lithium-ion Battery Pack.reasoning: Graphite is the standard anode active material enabling lithium intercalation, essential for battery charge-discharge cycle.

Touchpad Module.name: Glass

Touchpad Module.name: Copper
Touchpad Module.reasoning: Copper is used to form the conductive sensor grid and interconnections inside the touchpad.

Touchpad Module.name: Silicon
Touchpad Module.reasoning: Silicon is the semiconductor material used in the touchpad controller ICs, absolutely essential for processing input signals.

Touchpad Module.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Touchpad Module.reasoning: PET is commonly used as an insulating or protective film layer within the touchpad construction though alternatives exist.

Air Cooling System.name: Copper
